# Glossary {#sec-apph}

This glossary collects acronyms, YAML keys, named concepts and symbols, with
links to their defining sections. Open the linked section for the assumptions
and scope needed to interpret a term. A reachable link alone does not establish
the completeness or accuracy of that explanation.

Acronyms expand shortened names. YAML keys identify input spellings; accepted
values and defaults belong with their input contracts. Named concepts link to
defining sections rather than carrying a separate short definition here.
Symbols pair meanings with destinations; @sec-appa supplies conventions and
units. First textual use is not necessarily a definition.

Acronym, key and symbol meanings also supply chapter-first-use notes; named
concepts link directly to their defining sections. The short note identifies
the term but does not replace the definition's assumptions and scope.

An entry marked **not defined here** records an absent definition explicitly.
Its usage link locates a place where the term occurs; it is not an alternative
definition. If no chapter uses the entry, the glossary says so. Neither absence
from this glossary nor that marker establishes that the corresponding feature
is unsupported by the code.

**Not provided:** term-specific meanings and definition destinations. The
current glossary contains no entries in any of its four groups. The headings
below are a lookup structure, not evidence that all terms used in the book have
been identified or defined. In particular, no glossary-based coverage of YAML
keys, acronyms, concepts or symbols is claimed.
